Use case: identity-preserve. Production 2D combat sprites for Mouse Frontier, matching the referenced APPROVED creature exactly: same species/anatomy, silhouette, face, proportions, palette, materials, pixel-art outline and shading. NEW authored intermediate poses, never rotations/duplicates of one picture. Transparent RGBA background, clean alpha in all gaps; no scenery, shadows, text, labels or grid. Layout EXACTLY 6 equal columns x 4 rows, 1536x1024, 24 cells256x256. ONE complete creature in every cell, 16px edge clearance, consistent scale, fixed camera and baseline. Default face RIGHT in matching three-quarter profile; a front-facing reference can retain its approved view. Animate left to right in each row. Row1 MELEE: ready, prepare/wind-up, launch, maximum strike, follow-through, recovery to ready. Row2 RANGED: ready, prepare, aim/charge, release, recoil, recover. Row3 HIT: ready, initial flinch, recoil, maximum stagger, regain balance, return ready (do NOT fall fully over in a survivable hit). Row4 DEATH: ready, buckle/weaken, begin falling, collapse, settle, motionless final downed body with closed eyes. Last row never revives or loops. No gore. No extra accessories or limbs. CRITICAL CORRECTION: the reference depicts ONE ordinary eagle creature with exactly ONE white-feathered HEAD, ONE yellow hooked BEAK, ONE neck, TWO broad wings and TWO talons. It is NOT a two-headed bird. The broad dark feathered masses on either side are WINGS, never extra necks or faces. Exactly ONE head/face/beak in every one of the 24 cells. Preserve black/dark-grey feathers, white head/neck ruff, gold feather accents, red-and-gold wingtip markings, two golden talons and original overall body proportions. Head and beak face right. Row1 talon rake with a single-head peck, row2 forward wing gust with a few detached feather streaks (no gun), row3 hit flinch with wings partly folding, row4 weakened wings, land, then collapse resting on side with ONE head and closed eye. No added heads, beaks, limbs, hats or equipment. Use ONLY this original base art as identity reference; disregard any earlier generated two-headed version.
Repair: row2 column4 must contain a complete eagle; six bodies per row, reduce effects to fit cells.
